people.name: Asa
people.line: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

people.name: Ben-hadad
people.line: King of Aram, contemporary of Asa and Baasha.

people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

people.name: Hezion
people.line: Grandfather of Ben-Hadad, king of Aram.

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

people.name: Tabrimmon
people.line: Father of Ben-hadad I, king of Syria

translations.web: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered it into the hand of his servants. Then King Asa sent them to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,
translations.bsb: So Asa withdrew all the silver and gold that remained in the treasuries of the house of the LORD and the royal palace. He entrusted it to his servants and sent them with this message to Ben-hadad son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, the king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus:
translations.kjv: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Benhadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
